name: stepfun-tts
description: >- Generates speech with StepFun contextual TTS, including Chinese/Japanese speech, emotional delivery, inline natural-language directions, cloned voices and batch voice lines. Supports native HTTP, SSE, WebSocket and voice/file lifecycle requests, plus migration from step-tts-2. Use for 阶跃 TTS, 语音合成 or 配音. Not for transcription (use stepfun-asr).
author: daymade
